description: This file defines the LocalDispatcherFactory interface in the org.apache.ofbiz.service package, which declares a method for creating LocalDispatcher instances based on a name and a delegator. It serves as a factory interface for LocalDispatcher objects within the Ofbiz framework's service layer.

classes.name: LocalDispatcherFactory
classes.description: An interface defining a factory for creating LocalDispatcher objects, with a method to instantiate or retrieve existing instances based on name and delegator.

methods.name: createLocalDispatcher
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a LocalDispatcher instance given a name and a Delegator.
